headline: CBIC corrigendum corrects CGST (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (G.S.R. 919(E))
reference: Corrigenda to CGST (Amendment) Rules, 2026, G.S.R. 919(E) dated 26 October 2026 (F. No. CBIC-20001/1/2026-GST)
summary_points: CBIC has issued corrigenda to the English version of the CGST (Amendment) Rules, 2026 published vide G.S.R. 919(E) dated 26 October 2026.
Most changes are typographical or renumbering fixes, such as clause numbering, 'Aadhar' to 'Aadhaar' and 'permission' to 'consent'.
Some corrections change substance: provisos on revalidation of RFD-05/RFD-06 are inserted and the ITC refund declaration wording is revised.

rows: Duty to 'keep and maintain' extended to 'the books of accounts and records'
Lines 8-9 replaced: officer to issue an order communicated electronically, within days from receipt of application under sub-rule (6)
New provisos: FORM GST RFD-06 order need not be revalidated; RFD-05 payment order must be revalidated if refund is not disbursed in the same financial year
Document list renumbered; proof of address list now includes property tax receipt, Khata copy, electricity and water bills
Refund declaration now says ITC claimed excludes ITC blocked under section 17(5) and ITC on nil-rated or fully exempt supplies
Reference to last amendment updated to notification No. 20/2025-Central Tax, G.S.R. 950(E), 31 December 2025

who_is_affected: Registered taxpayers, refund claimants, GST practitioners and tax officers relying on the CGST (Amendment) Rules, 2026 as published on 26 October 2026.
action_required: Read the original G.S.R. 919(E) together with this corrigendum, and update checklists, refund declarations and registration document lists accordingly.

social.linkedin:
CBIC has issued corrigenda to the CGST (Amendment) Rules, 2026 (G.S.R. 919(E) dated 26 October 2026), with the corrigendum dated 18 November 2026.

Most of the 40 corrections are typographical or renumbering fixes, such as 'Aadhar' to 'Aadhaar' and 'permission' to 'consent'.

A few corrections deserve attention:
- New provisos on revalidation: the RFD-06 order need not be revalidated, but the RFD-05 payment order must be revalidated if the refund is not disbursed in the same financial year.
- 'Seven days' becomes 'seven working days' on page 149.
- The ITC refund declaration now excludes ITC blocked under section 17(5) and ITC on nil-rated or fully exempt supplies.
- The proof of address list now includes property tax receipt, Khata copy and utility bills.

Practitioners should read the amended Rules along with the corrigendum before updating refund and registration workflows.

Please verify with the official CBIC notification before acting.
